question: The volume of a cone is 98 cm³. If the height of the cone is 7 cm, then the area of the base is
solution:
**Given:**

Volume = 98 cm³

height = 7 cm

**Concept used: **

Volume = 1over3πr²h

Area of base = π r²

**Calculation: **

⇒ dfrac{1}{3} times dfrac{22}{7} x r² x 7 = 98

⇒ 22 r² = 98 x 3

⇒ 11 r² = 49 x 3

⇒ 11 r² = 147

⇒ r² = 147over11

⇒ Area of base = dfrac{22}{7} times dfrac{147}{11}

⇒ Area of base = 2 x 21

⇒ Area of base = 42 cm²

**∴ The area of the base is 42 cm².**
